title: Project Website Positioning Matrix v1 — Rig Relay
description: Competitive and conceptual positioning map. Not a market analysis — a product clarity exercise to ensure every word on the front door has a known referent.

positioning_axes.description: How deeply the product governs agent actions. Scale: advisory → soft gate → cryptographic receipt → authority spine.
positioning_axes.evidence: Cross-Surface Authority Spine v1 is canonical. GovernanceDecision is typed, not boolean. Every decision produces ReceiptEnvelope evidence.

positioning_axes.description: How durable and replayable the evidence trail is. Scale: chat log → structured log → receipt → schema-governed JSONL → Merkle-linked envelope → DuckDB projection.
positioning_axes.evidence: Receipt manifest enriched with governance fields. DuckDB governance decisions projection exists. Merkle-linked receipt store. 400+ schemas govern all artifacts.

positioning_axes.description: Which surfaces have active governance. Scale: one surface → multiple with gaps → every surface gated → cross-surface authority spine.
positioning_axes.evidence: Cockpit, CLI, MCP, ACP, WebSocket all governed. Cross-surface authority spine v1 maps all 9 surfaces with explicit rules.

positioning_axes.description: How mutations are gated. Scale: no gate → advisory → dry-run-default → --execute-with-receipt → cryptographic.
positioning_axes.evidence: CLI scripts default to dry-run or require --execute with approval receipt. MCP mutation tier blocked. GitHub Trust Spine planned for cryptographic enforcement.

positioning_axes.description: How telemetry is handled. Scale: opt-out-only → opt-in → content-light → four-category model → degraded-behavior matrix.
positioning_axes.evidence: Product telemetry (first-party, opt-out), remote contribution (consent-gated), local operational observability (mandatory), enterprise audit/evidence (mandatory).

positioning_axes.description: How the product is deployed. Scale: cloud-only → hybrid → local-first → local-first + hosted planned.
positioning_axes.evidence: Local-first architecture. uv pip install or uv tool install. Postgres enterprise substrate planned. Hosted/team deployment planned, not implemented.

positioning_axes.description: How many protocol surfaces the product exposes. Scale: one → two → multiple → unified spine.
positioning_axes.evidence: MCP (16 tools, 6 resources, 3 prompts), ACP (agent sessions), WebSocket (cockpit), CLI (20+ scripts), GitHub App integration. All governed by single spine.

contrast_statements.rig_relay_statement: AI coding agents execute. Rig Relay governs. You need both. Without governance, every agent call is an untraceable mutation. Rig Relay gives you the authority spine.
LLM API wrappers add convenience. Rig Relay adds control. Receipts, approvals, content-light telemetry, cross-surface authority — these are not convenience features.
Observability platforms watch production. Rig Relay governs development. Same rigor, different surface. JSON/JSONL/CSV evidence, DuckDB queries, schema-governed artifacts.
CI/CD deploys artifacts. Rig Relay produces evidence artifacts. Build integrity meets agent integrity. SBOM and provenance for agent decisions, not just dependencies.

tone_guidelines: Serious, not sensational. Rig Relay is a control surface, not a magic box.
Evidence-backed, not aspirational. Every claim on the front door must have a source artifact link.
Product-sharp, not academic. The front door sells the product. The generated docs prove it.
Honest about limitations. If something is planned or deferred, say so. No overclaims.
Developer-first, not enterprise-obfuscated. Clear language, clear CTAs, clear evidence links.
